Data & privacy
HISTORY
Search history

Remember searches on this device. Search history never needs to leave this machine.

Clear history
Your Colosseum activity

Keep watch and reading activity for Monthly Portrait, recent activity, completion history and personal media insights.

Clear activity
Cross-device history

Sync watch and reading history between your signed-in devices. Turning this off can still leave activity available locally.

YOUR ACCOUNT DATA
Export my data

Create a portable copy of the account data Colosseum holds for you.

Request export
What Colosseum keeps where

These controls sit on top of a simple boundary: portable account state can follow you, while machine-specific and sensitive data stays outside ordinary sync.

Can follow your account

Portable state with a safe sync contract.

Continue progress

Portable resume points and progress.

Collection

Titles and shelves you save.

History

When cross-device history is enabled.

Portable preferences

Account-level choices with approved owners.

Stays on this device

Machine-owned data that ordinary sync does not carry.

Search history

Kept locally when search history is enabled.

Window & session state

Open sessions, geometry, PiP and machine state.

Paths & media

Local files and filesystem locations.

Downloads & caches

Machine-local acquisition and rebuildable data.

Secrets are a separate boundary.

Passwords, recovery keys, session tokens and API credentials do not enter ordinary account sync. Filesystem paths and secret-bearing fields are blocked from those payloads too.

ACCOUNT
Delete Colosseum account

Permanently delete the account and its server-side account data. Local media files on your devices are not part of account deletion.

Delete account
This is permanent.

Deleting the account removes its server-side identity and portable cloud data. Local media files stay on your devices. Provider backups follow the provider's retention policy; Colosseum keeps only a capability-protected retry receipt for up to 30 days.

Cancel
Continue to delete
